summary: Iteration 24 — Tested Messagerie redesign, Boîte à idées, Anniversaires, birthday popup + cake pill + meal-points bonus split. 21/21 pytest backend tests PASS. Frontend flows all working: birthday popup fires with confetti + gift cards, /me/birthday/claim credits 10 pts w/ 30d expiry, popup does not reappear on reload, header cake pill only on Idriss (not Marcus), sidebar has Boîte à idées + Anniversaires entries, ideas full flow (create anonymous → vote → admin moderate → delete) works, messagerie flat list with tabs Toutes/Non lues/Favoris (unread badge auto-clears on open, favorite toggle switches conversation between tabs), message send + display works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 6702 lines — recommend splitting into modules (ideas, birthdays, channels, meal_points, orders) for maintainability.
IdeaModerator save button was missing data-testid; I added `idea-moderate-save` for future automation (minor testability fix).
test_credentials: Idriss: emp-idriss-malonga (birthday today, employé). Marcus: emp-marcus-simeo (admin, requires ms_admin_mode=true).
seed_data_creation: Reset Idriss's birthday_popup_year and birthday_bonus via mongosh before UI test so popup could fire fresh. After test, birthday_bonus is granted (10 pts, 30d expiry).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Idriss's birthday_popup_year is now set to 2026 and birthday_bonus is claimed — popup won't re-fire. To retest, run: mongosh test_database --eval 'db.employees.updateOne({id:"emp-idriss-malonga"},{$unset:{birthday_popup_year:"",birthday_bonus:""}})'. Test file test_iter24_ideas_birthdays_messagerie.py covers 21 endpoints and can be re-run.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. All 9 features from the review request work correctly on both backend and frontend.
